title: Multi - Skilled Technician
jobDescription:
The Multi-Skilled Technician is responsible for carrying out preventive, corrective, and reactive maintenance of building facilities and equipment. The role requires expertise in multiple technical areas including electrical, plumbing, HVAC, carpentry, and general civil works to ensure smooth operations of the facility. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Perform routine inspection, maintenance, and repair of facility equipment (electrical panels, lighting, plumbing, HVAC, fire systems, etc.). Diagnose issues and troubleshoot breakdowns across multiple technical trades. Carry out minor carpentry, painting, and civil repair works as required. Execute preventive maintenance schedules to reduce downtime. Ensure compliance with safety procedures, energy efficiency, and operational standards. Support installation, commissioning, and replacement of building equipment. Respond to facility service requests in a timely manner. Maintain proper records of maintenance activities and report to the Facility Supervisor. Coordinate with external vendors and contractors for specialized repairs. Keep tools, materials, and work areas in safe and organized condition.

title: Facility Executive - Soft Services
jobDescription:
Job Summary: The Facility Executive
- Soft Services is responsible for overseeing and managing all non-technical, non-engineering services at the facility, ensuring a clean, safe, and well-maintained environment for occupants. This includes managing housekeeping, security, pest control, landscaping, waste management, and other related services. The executive will ensure that these services are delivered in line with the organization’s standards and client requirements. Housekeeping Management: Oversee and monitor daily cleaning activities, ensuring cleanliness, hygiene, and sanitization of the facility. Schedule and manage cleaning staff, ensuring optimal staffing levels for routine and deep cleaning activities. Inspect premises for cleanliness and orderliness; resolve issues in a timely manner. Security Management: Coordinate with security teams to ensure safety protocols are adhered to and the premises are secure. Regularly review security measures, conduct audits, and improve protocols as necessary. Address and resolve security-related incidents or concerns. Pest Control: Schedule regular pest control services and ensure compliance with health and safety regulations. Monitor pest control treatments and assess effectiveness, ensuring zero tolerance for pest infestations. Waste Management: Oversee waste disposal procedures and ensure adherence to sustainability and environmental guidelines. Implement waste reduction and recycling initiatives where possible. Vendor Management: Liaise with third-party service providers for soft services like cleaning, pest control, and landscaping. Evaluate vendor performance regularly and ensure services are delivered as per SLAs (Service Level Agreements). Coordinate contract renewals and negotiate with vendors for cost effective services. Budget Management: Assist in preparing and managing the budget for soft services. Monitor expenses, ensuring efficient use of resources and cost optimization. Customer Service: Respond to any soft services-related complaints or requests from internal staff or clients. Ensure timely resolution of issues and maintain high levels of satisfaction. Compliance with SLA Metrics: Ensure that all service operations meet the agreed-upon performance levels for uptime, response time, resolution time, etc. Regular reporting and documentation of SLA adherence Resource Management: Ensure appropriate staffing and resource allocation to meet the demands of the SLA. Monitor workforce performance and resource efficiency in relation to service delivery Reporting: Generate and submit regular reports on soft service operations, including performance metrics, issues, and solutions. Track inventory and ensure adequate stock of cleaning supplies, consumables, and other necessary items.

title: Facility Executive - Technical
jobDescription:
Job Summary : BHIVE is looking for a proactive and technically strong Facility Executive
- Technical to oversee and manage all technical aspects of our workspace facilities. This role requires hands-on expertise in electrical, HVAC, plumbing, DG, and building maintenance systems along with strong vendor management and problem-solving skills. The ideal candidate will ensure smooth daily operations, timely issue resolution, and optimal uptime of all technical infrastructure across BHIVE centres. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. Technical Infrastructure Management Oversee daily operations of electrical, mechanical, HVAC, plumbing, CCTV, access control, fire safety, and DG systems. Ensure all technical equipment is functioning effectively with minimal downtime. Conduct routine inspections to identify maintenance needs and technical failures.
2. Preventive & Breakdown Maintenance Develop and monitor preventive maintenance schedules for all equipment. Coordinate and supervise repair works, ensuring timely resolution of issues. Maintain logbooks, checklists, and maintenance reports.
3. Vendor and Contractor Management Engage, coordinate, and supervise external technical vendors, AMC providers, electricians, HVAC technicians, and plumbers. Ensure vendors adhere to SLAs, timelines, and quality standards. Evaluate vendor performance and maintain cost control.
4. Compliance and Safety Ensure compliance with building codes, safety regulations, and audit requirements. Conduct periodic fire safety checks and coordinate with fire safety vendors. Maintain compliance records and ensure SOP adherence across sites.
5. Budgeting and Inventory Monitor and control technical operations budget, including maintenance costs and repair expenses. Maintain inventory of technical equipment, tools, and consumables (lights, switches, cables, filters, etc.). Raise PR/PO for technical requirements.
6. Centre Support and Coordination Support centre managers and operations teams with any technical or facility-related escalations. Ensure minimal disruption to member experience and workspace operations. Coordinates with cross-functional teams including Projects, Admin, and IT.

title: Treasury Executive
jobDescription:
Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. Investor Relationship & Payout Management Act as the key point of contact for investors on payout-related queries, ensuring timely and professional communication. Manage investor payouts (interest and exit/principal) across multiple entities within due dates. Maintain and update investor payout data on dashboards/portals, ensuring accuracy and transparency. Build and sustain strong investor relationships through proactive updates and issue resolution. Coordinate with Investors, Tax, and GL teams for accurate data submission supporting tax filing and book closure.
2. Interest Calculation & Fund Management Compute interest accruals and payouts accurately as per investment terms, schedules, and applicable rates. Reconcile interest computations against ledgers and investor agreements; resolve discrepancies promptly. Monitor and manage cash inflows, outflows, and overall liquidity. Prepare daily cash position reports and periodic cash flow forecasts.
3. Banking & Account Management Oversee daily banking operations across multiple bank and escrow accounts. Manage fund transfers and settlements via NEFT, RTGS, and other modes, ensuring accurate execution. Open, close, and manage bank and escrow accounts as required by business needs. Handle treasury investments and credit card settlement processes.
4. Reporting, Audit & Compliance Ensure timely submission of MIS reports and compliance documentation. Maintain accurate treasury documentation and ensure adherence to loan covenants. Support internal and external audits with complete and accurate treasury data.
5. Process Improvement & Controls Develop and implement SOPs and strong internal controls for treasury and investor payout processes. Identify opportunities to automate and streamline treasury, banking, and reporting operations. Ensure accuracy in remittances, fund movement, and investor communications always. Candidate Requirements B.Com graduate with 3-4 relevant experience in treasury, accounts, or investor relations. Strong working knowledge of interest calculation methods, banking instruments (NEFT/RTGS), and reconciliation. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence to interact directly with investors. High proficiency in Excel; familiarity with treasury/ERP systems and investor dashboards preferred.

title: Project Planning and Coordinator
jobDescription:
Job Summary: We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Project Planning & Coordinator to drive end-to-end planning, coordination, and execution of workplace fit-out and construction projects. The role will act as the central coordination point between Design, Projects, Procurement, Finance, Facilities, and external consultants to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. The ideal candidate should possess strong architectural knowledge, project planning expertise, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to monitor multiple projects simultaneously while proactively identifying and mitigating execution risks. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. Project Planning & Scheduling: Develop comprehensive project plans, timelines, and execution schedules for multiple ongoing projects. Prepare detailed project roadmaps with defined milestones, dependencies, and critical paths. Track project progress against planned timelines and identify potential delays. Recommend corrective actions to ensure timely project completion. Coordinate project kick-off meetings and establish execution plans with all stakeholders.
2. Cross-Functional Coordination: Coordinate with Architecture, Design, Procurement, Projects, Finance, Legal, Facilities, and Operations teams throughout the project lifecycle. Ensure seamless communication between internal teams, consultants, contractors, and vendors. Facilitate regular project review meetings and document action items and progress updates. Track action closures and ensure stakeholder accountability.
3. Project Monitoring & Reporting: Maintain project dashboards highlighting schedule, budget, risks, dependencies, and completion status. Generate weekly and monthly MIS reports for leadership. Monitor project KPIs including timeline adherence, cost variance, quality metrics, and resource utilization. Present project updates and risk assessments to senior management.
4. Budget & Cost Coordination: Coordinate with Procurement and Finance teams to ensure alignment between project execution and approved budgets. Monitor project expenditure against approved estimates. Track purchase requests, work orders, invoices, and payment milestones. Highlight potential cost overruns and recommend mitigation strategies.
5. Risk Management : Identify execution risks, bottlenecks, and inter-departmental dependencies. Develop mitigation plans to minimize project delays and operational disruptions. Escalate critical issues proactively with recommended solutions. Maintain project risk registers and closure trackers.
6. Documentation & Governance: Maintain complete project documentation including drawings, BOQs, contracts, approvals, schedules, and project reports. Ensure version control and documentation accuracy across projects. Track statutory approvals and compliance requirements wherever applicable. Support project governance by ensuring adherence to organizational processes and reporting standards.
7. Vendor & Consultant Coordination: Coordinate with architects, consultants, contractors, and vendors throughout execution. Monitor deliverables and ensure timely completion as per agreed schedules. Track consultant and vendor performance against project commitments. Support contract administration and project documentation.
8. Quality & Compliance: Coordinate with project execution teams to ensure quality standards are maintained. Monitor project deliverables against approved specifications and design intent. Ensure compliance with safety guidelines, project processes, and regulatory requirements. Desired Candidate Profile : Strong experience in Construction Management is mandatory. Proven expertise in architectural design coordination and multidisciplinary project management. Hands-on experience in commercial interior fit-outs, workplace design execution, or large-scale construction projects. Strong understanding of construction drawings, GFC drawings, BOQs, material specifications, and execution methodologies. Experience conducting site quality inspections and driving quality improvement initiatives. Familiarity with construction project lifecycle from concept design through project handover. Proficiency in project management tools such as MS Project, Primavera, Auto CAD , and advanced Microsoft Excel is preferred. Ability to coordinate with multiple consultants, contractors, and cross-functional stakeholders simultaneously. Strong understanding of construction quality standards, safety practices, and statutory compliance. Experience and

QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor’s degree in architecture (B.Arch) is mandatory. Master’s degree in architecture (M.Arch) is preferred. 8-12 years of experience in project planning, architectural coordination, construction management, or workplace fit-out projects. Experience in commercial real estate, coworking, corporate interiors, hospitality, or large-scale infrastructure projects is highly preferred. Strong understanding of project planning methodologies and construction execution. Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional coordination skills. Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities. Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. Excellent communication and presentation skills. Technical Skills MS Project / Primavera (preferred) Microsoft Excel (Advanced) Auto CAD Revit (preferred) Microsoft Power Point ERP/Project Management Tools Project Tracking & MIS Reporting Key Competencies Project Planning & Scheduling Cross-functional Coordination Project Governance Risk Identification & Mitigation Budget Tracking Stakeholder Management Execution Monitoring Documentation & Compliance Vendor Management Analytical Thinking Attention to Detail Time Management Decision Making Communication & Collaboration Success Measures 95%+ adherence to planned project timelines. Timely closure of project milestones and action items. Reduction in project delays through proactive planning and coordination. Accurate and timely leadership dashboards and MIS reporting. Effective coordination across all project stakeholders. High-quality documentation and governance compliance. Successful delivery of projects within approved budget and quality standards.

title: Senior Investment Manager
jobDescription:
Role Overview : The Senior Investment Manager is a senior individual contributor and key capital raiser for BHIVE Capital. This role is specifically designed for wealth management professionals who bring a ready, personal HNI network capable of deploying ₹10-12 Cr from their own relationships. The candidate will independently originate, pitch, and close high-value investments in FOCO, CCD, and CCPS, while also supporting and mentoring the investment manager team. This is not a portfolio management or back-office role. It is a senior front-line fundraising role where the candidate’s own network and credibility with HNI investors is the primary selection criterion. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. Network-Led Capital Raising (Primary) • Leverage personal HNI/UHNI network to originate, pitch, and close high-value investments in FOCO, CCD, and CCPS • Bring minimum 100+ qualified HNI relationships capable of investing ₹10L-₹1 Cr+ tickets • Target to activate and deploy ₹10-12 Cr from personal network within the first 6-9 months • Build a sustained pipeline of new investor relationships beyond the initial network
2. High-Value Investor Relationship Management • Own and manage a portfolio of high-net-worth investor relationships
- including UHNI investors and small family offices • Lead complex, multi-meeting investor conversations involving equity risk, lock-in periods, and IPO timelines • Represent BHIVE at investor events, wealth management networking sessions, and partner meetings • Handle senior investor escalations and relationship-critical situations with maturity and authority
3. Wealth Platform & Distribution Partnerships • Identify, engage, and onboard wealth management platforms, private banks, and boutique wealth advisors as distribution partners • Negotiate commercial terms and engagement models with platform partners • Build and manage a pipeline of platform partnerships that create repeatable, scalable capital inflow
4. Team Support & Knowledge Transfer • Support and guide the Investment Manager team on complex investor conversations and product pitching • Share best practices on HNI engagement, objection handling, and relationship deepening • Provide feedback to the Finance Head on product positioning, market response, and investor sentiment
5. Investor Communications & Reporting • Lead preparation of investor-facing materials
- presentations, product notes, performance summaries • Plan and execute investor events
- dinners, briefings, webinars, property tours • Work with the IR team on monthly payout communications, portfolio updates, and escalation resolution
6. Market Intelligence • Track competitor fundraising structures in alternatives, real estate yield products, and private wealth distribution • Provide periodic insights to leadership on market terms, investor expectations, and product-market fit Collaboration and communication : Proactive monitoring and collaboration with team members and internal departments are necessary to guarantee seamless operations at the Centre. How the role Interact with other teams or Individuals : Ensure effective communication and coordination between different cross functional teams to align the investment function with overall business goals. title: Investment Manager
jobDescription:
Role Overview : The Investment Manager will own end-to-end lifecycle management of a portfolio of 300-500 individual investors with AUM of up to ₹100 Cr. The primary mandate is to raise fresh capital from existing investors and select new investors into BHIVE’s equity-linked products
- FOCO, CCD, and CCPS
- while maintaining the asset leasing portfolio and ensuring world-class investor experience. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. Investor Portfolio Management • Own the full lifecycle of 300-500 assigned investors
- from onboarding through renewals, rollovers, and migrations to new products • Maintain regular, proactive communication with investors on their portfolio status, monthly payouts, and relevant updates • Handle investor queries, concerns, and escalations with speed and professionalism • Manage investor communications for maturity events, reinvestments, and product transitions
2. Fundraising
- Equity Instruments (Primary Focus) • Pitch and close investments in FOCO (property equity), CCD (convertible debentures), and CCPS (preference shares) to existing and new HNI investors • Convert existing asset leasing investors into equity products
- understanding their financial profile and tailoring the pitch accordingly • Achieve monthly fundraising targets across instrument categories (see Target above) • Prepare for and participate in CEO/leadership-led investor meetings and events
3. Asset Leasing Portfolio
- Floor Maintenance • Ensure the ₹2 Cr/month asset leasing floor is consistently met as a baseline before equity incentives apply • Drive renewals and reinvestments from the existing asset leasing investor base
4. Documentation & Compliance • Handle end-to-end investment documentation
- DSA, SSA, DTD, KYC, and risk acknowledgement forms • Ensure all investments are processed in compliance with applicable regulations and internal policies • Maintain accurate CRM records with source attribution, investor status, and pipeline data
5. Research & Strategy Support • Support the Finance Head / investments team with portfolio analytics, investor behavior insights, and product positioning feedback • Track market benchmarks and competitor product structures in alternatives and real estate yield products • Contribute to research on future product structures (AIF, SM REIT, etc.) as BHIVE’s capital platform evolves Collaboration and communication : Proactive monitoring and collaboration with team members and internal departments are necessary to guarantee seamless operations at the Centre. How the role Interact with other teams or Individuals : Ensure effective communication and coordination between different cross functional teams to align the investment function with overall business goals. title: Compliance and Licensing
jobDescription:
Job Summary: As our coworking portfolio continues to scale across multiple locations, we are looking for a Compliance and Licensing Professional to own statutory and regulatory compliance end-to-end across all centres. This role will act as the single point of ownership for statutory licenses, approvals, renewals, and regulatory coordination, ensuring centres remain operationally compliant while enabling fast and smooth expansion. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Own the complete lifecycle of statutory licenses and registrations across all centers (including Shops &Establishment, Trade License, Signage licenses, Labour Department registrations, Fire NOC, Lift and DG licenses etc.) Maintain and continuously update a centralized compliance and renewal tracker. Apply for licenses and approvals required for new centers and expansions. Manage renewals proactively to ensure zero compliance lapses. Coordinate with municipal bodies, fire authorities, labour departments, and other licensing authorities. Support inspections, regulatory visits, and authority interactions. Act as the first point of response for compliance with queries, notices, or inspections. Ensure statutory notices and licenses are properly displayed at operational centers. Support and oversee all labour department licenses and registrations for corporate headquarters. Partner with operations teams to ensure compliance with readiness before center launches. Track location-specific regulatory requirements and ensure documentation of readiness at all times. Why This Role Matters This role institutionalizes compliance ownership across the organization by: Reducing regulatory and operational risk. Preventing delays in center launches. Improving accountability and audit readiness. Allowing the legal team to focus on strategic and advisory work instead of administrative tracking. Qualifications and Skills: 8 -10 years of experience in compliance, licensing, regulatory coordination, or operations compliance. Experience interacting with government authorities or managing statutory approvals preferred. Strong organizational and tracking skills with high attention to detail. Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment. Practical problem-solver who can drive outcomes independently. Ability to coordinate across operations, HR, facilities, external relations, and external consultants.

title: Senior Copywriter
jobDescription:
Job Summary : BHIVE is looking for a highly creative and strategic Senior Copywriter to lead the development of compelling, conversion-driven content across digital and offline channels. The ideal candidate must currently be working in a pure copywriting role and possess strong expertise in crafting impactful brand messaging, campaign narratives, and performance focused communication. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Develop clear, persuasive, and engaging copy for digital campaigns, websites, landing pages, emails, social media, ads, brochures, and other marketing assets. Create campaign concepts, taglines, brand messaging frameworks, and storytelling narratives. Collaborate with designers, marketers, and business stakeholders to deliver integrated campaigns. Write high-converting copy for paid media and performance marketing initiatives. Ensure consistency in brand voice and tone across all customer touchpoints. Review, edit, and enhance content created by internal teams or external agencies. Conduct audience and competitor research to create relevant and impactful messaging. Mentor junior writers and contribute to creative brainstorming sessions. Requirements : 6+ years of overall professional experience. Minimum 3 years in a dedicated copywriting role (mandatory). Current role should primarily involve copywriting responsibilities. Strong portfolio showcasing campaign copy, digital marketing assets, ad copy, and brand storytelling. Excellent command of English with exceptional writing, editing, and proofreading skills. Experience working with marketing, branding, and performance teams. Ability to balance creativity with business objectives and conversion goals. Preferred : Experience in real estate, coworking, hospitality, lifestyle, D2C, or consumer brands. Exposure to AI-assisted content creation tools especially Claude. Experience managing internal stakeholders. Collaboration and communication : Proactive monitoring and collaboration with team members and internal departments are necessary to guarantee seamless operations at the Centre. How the role Interact with other teams or Individuals : Ensure effective communication and coordination between different cross functional teams to align the marketing function with overall business goals.

title: Head - Enterprise Sales
jobDescription:
Job Summary: BHIVE Group is looking for a dynamic and strategic Head
- Enterprise Sales to lead enterprise business development and revenue growth across our managed office portfolio. This leadership role will be responsible for driving large enterprise sales, building high-value client relationships, leading a high-performing sales team, and ensuring seamless deal execution from acquisition to expansion. BHIVE is entering its next phase of growth-moving beyond mid-sized workspace clients to serve large, multi-year, high-commitment enterprise customers and, over time, Global Capability Centers (GCCs). Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Enterprise Sales Leadership Lead and drive enterprise sales strategy to achieve revenue and occupancy targets across BHIVE locations. Build and manage a strong pipeline of large enterprise clients, GCCs, startups, and strategic accounts. Develop and execute go-to-market plans for managed office and solutions. Identify new market opportunities, partnerships, and growth channels. Team Management & Capability Building Lead, mentor, and manage a team of Business Development Managers and Sales professionals. Set clear sales targets, KPIs, and performance expectations for the team. Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching sessions, and capability-building initiatives. Foster a high-performance and collaborative sales culture. Client Relationship Management Serve as the key point of contact for enterprise clients and strategic stakeholders. Build long-term relationships with CXOs, decision-makers, IPCs, and channel partners. Ensure exceptional customer experience throughout the client lifecycle. Proactively manage client expectations and resolve escalations effectively Deal Closure & Commercial Negotiations Lead end-to-end deal management including commercial negotiations, proposals, agreements, addendums, and closures. Collaborate with legal and finance teams to ensure compliance with company policies and statutory requirements. Drive faster deal closures while ensuring profitability and risk mitigation. Project Coordination & Delivery Act as the business lead during workspace build-outs and project execution. Coordinate closely with design, projects, operations, and facility teams to ensure timely project delivery. Ensure client requirements are translated effectively into execution plans and delivered to satisfaction. IPC & Channel Partner Management Build and strengthen relationships with IPCs, brokers, and channel partners to generate qualified leads. Create strategic engagement plans with IPC networks to drive consistent business opportunities. Ensure effective lead allocation and tracking within the sales team. Desired Candidate Profile: 14-18 years of experience in Enterprise Sales, Business Development, or Strategic Account Management. Proven track record in enterprise leasing, managed office spaces, commercial real estate, or related sectors. Strong experience in handling large enterprise accounts and high-value negotiations. Demonstrated leadership experience managing high-performing sales teams. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills. Strong understanding of commercial contracts, legal documentation, and sales operations. Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with strong ownership and accountability. Preferred Industry Experience: Managed Office Spaces Commercial Real Estate IPC / Workplace Solutions Hospitality / Flexible Workspace Solutions Enterprise B2B Services

title: IT Security & Governance Lead
jobDescription:
About BHIVE Group BHIVE is one of India’s leading managed workspace companies a network of 28+ premium coworking and managed office spaces across Bengaluru and other cities, catering to startups, SMEs, and enterprise clients. Known for its design-forward spaces, enterprise-grade infrastructure, and community first culture. With a workforce of 300+ employees, a rapidly scaling digital footprint, and operations spanning multiple facilities, BHIVE’s IT function is the backbone of secure, reliable, and compliant business operations. The organisation is in an active phase of digital transformation
- investing in security frameworks, enterprise platforms (ZOHO ERP, Microsoft 365) and AI-enabled productivity
- making this a pivotal role at a critical juncture. Job Summary The IT Security & Governance Lead will be BHIVE Group’s dedicated security and governance role, reporting directly to the SVP
- IT. This is a senior contributor role that combines strategic governance ownership with hands-on technical execution. The incumbent will be responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalising BHIVE’s end-to-end cybersecurity posture
- spanning workplace platforms, endpoints, network infrastructure, cloud environments, and emerging technology adoption. Beyond technical controls, this role is central to BHIVE’s regulatory readiness (DPDP Act, CERT-In), AI governance, and the formulation of policies, SOPs, and documentation that embed security into every layer of the organisation. The right person will be equally comfortable writing a security policy, leading an incident response, presenting a risk register Key Responsibilities Workplace Platform & Email Security Secure and govern the Microsoft 365 environment
- including identity protection, MFA enforcement, Conditional Access, and Microsoft Defender suite administration. Own email security governance and share point governance, ensuring robust data protection and domain integrity across all BHIVE platforms Cybersecurity Governance, Policy & Compliance Build and maintain BHIVE’s cybersecurity governance framework
- policies, risk registers, SOPs, and control documentation
- aligned to ISO 27001 & NIST obligations. Lead the organisation’s DPDP Act compliance programme, conduct periodic security posture assessments, and present prioritised remediation roadmaps. Network & Infrastructure Security Embed security principles into network design and architecture reviews
- covering segmentation, zero-trust, firewall governance, and secure remote access. Own vulnerability management from scanning through remediation, ensuring continuous coverage across all network-connected assets and cloud workloads. Endpoint, MDM & Detection Controls Evaluate, deploy, and manage MDM and EDR/XDR solutions; enforce endpoint hardening baselines and DLP controls across corporate and BYOD devices. Maintain end-to-end threat visibility
- tuning detection rules, triaging alerts, and driving timely response across all endpoint environments. Vendor, Software & Third-Party Governance Own third-party and vendor access governance
- risk assessments, JIT access controls, Saa S subscription management, and shadow IT mitigation. Collaborate with procurement and legal on security requirements in vendor contracts, and govern ERP access controls and audit trail configuration. AI Governance & Emerging Technology Develop and operationalise BHIVE’s AI Governance Policy, defining acceptable use, data handling guardrails, and risk controls for tools such as Microsoft Copilot ,Chat GPT,Claude etc. Monitor the evolving regulatory and threat landscape (DPDP, CERT-In, RBI guidelines) and brief on implications for BHIVE’s security posture. Security Awareness & Incident Response Run the organisation-wide security awareness programme
- phishing simulations, role-based training to build a security-first culture. Own the Incident Response Plan; coordinate incident response, and deliver regular security dashboards and risk reports to the SVP-IT. Required Qualifications Education Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field. Master’s degree or MBA (IT/Systems) is an advantage. Experience 8
- 12 years of overall IT/Security experience with a minimum of 4
- 6 years in a dedicated cybersecurity, governance, or infrastructure security role. Certifications One or more of equivalent industry-recognised security certification. Required Skills & Experience Microsoft 365 & Identity Security Hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365 security
- Conditional Access, Entra ID (Azure AD), Identity Protection, and Microsoft Secure Score. Proficiency with Microsoft Defender suite (Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Office 365, Defender for Identity). Practical experience configuring and governing (MDM/MAM) for device compliance and policy enforcement. Email & Domain Security Demonstrated implementation of DMARC ,DKIM, and SPF across multiple domains. Experience with email gateway configuration, anti-phishing policies, and safe links / safe attachments. DNS management and domain governance
- understanding of zone files, registrar security, and certificate management. Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) Experience building or significantly contributing to a cybersecurity governance framework
- policies, standards, procedures, and control documentation. Ability to conduct risk assessments, produce risk registers, and present findings to non-technical stakeholders. Strong SOP and policy writing skills
- clear, concise, and actionable documentation for both technical and business audiences. Endpoint & Detection Experience deploying and managing EDR / XDR solutions (Crowd Strike, Sentinel One, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, or equivalent). Ability to define and validate CIS benchmark-aligned hardening baselines for Windows and mac OS. Working knowledge of DLP technologies
- configuration, tuning, and exception management. Network & Infrastructure Security Understanding of network security principles
- firewall governance, network segmentation, zerotrust concepts, and secure remote access (VPN / ZTNA). Experience with vulnerability management tools (Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management). Collaboration & Communication Ability to communicate complex security concepts to C-level and non-technical audiences with clarity and confidence. Strong stakeholder management
- able to work with IT teams, business units like legal, HR, and external vendors. Comfortable presenting risk posture reports, dashboards, and incident briefings to senior leadership. Understanding of business continuity planning (BCP) and disaster recovery (DR) as they intersect with security Exposure to cloud security posture management (CSPM) for Azure or AWS environments.

title: WordPress CMS Developer and Business Automation Specialist
jobDescription:
We are looking for a hands-on builder who can own the complete lifecycle of digital operations, from integrating third-party tools and payment gateways to crafting Word Press experiences and automating multi-step workflows through power automate or similar tools
- without heavy reliance on traditional software engineering. You will work closely with business and product teams to translate requirements into live solutions with minimal engineering overhead. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Design, build, Enhance and maintain multiple Word Press sites with custom plugins, form logic, and business-specific modules on WP Engine Manage WP Engine hosting
- multisite configuration, staging environments, and deployment workflows Build and maintain end-to-end user journeys (lead -> checkout -> payment -> contract -> dashboard) using no-code/low-code platforms Sync data across CRM, marketing, and communication platforms Develop and maintain automation workflows for contract generation, billing, renewals, and resubmissions Manage customer support integrations (ticketing system, workflow system) including routing and ticketing logic Set up and maintain UTM tracking, campaign attribution, and lead source pipelines from ads to CRM Support AI agent/voice bot integrations (call routing, IVR design, round-robin logic) Debug and resolve issues across APIs, automation workflows, and payment flows MUST-HAVE SKILLS Hands-on Word Press development
